Everything is set up and verified.

- **Space:** `e2e-haiku-4a74c3c5` created (name set to the same id, since no display name was given).
- **Rule:** "E2E 88952a0b flight watch" (`.es-query`, consumer `stackAlerts`) in that space, with id `87e948f8-03b1-483b-9669-c5ca4b0a0f13`.
  - Index: `kibana_sample_data_flights`, time field `timestamp`
  - Query: `match_all`, so it counts every document in the window
  - Condition: fires when the count is greater than 0 over the last 5 minutes
  - Check interval: 1m (my choice, since none was specified)
- **Status:** enabled. A fetch of the rule afterward shows `enabled: true`. Its status is still `pending` because it hasn't run yet.
